published.citation: Solovyeva et al. (2019), MNRAS 484, L24, section 3.1: photosphere temperature T = 18 +/- 3 kK, estimated from the strengths of its He I and Fe II lines: 18000 +/- 3000 K, https://arxiv.org/abs/1901.05277

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: the star is placed by a catalogue row, so no Gaia DR3 source is read for it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
